description: Turn vocabulary and clues from your AI conversation into word searches, crosswords, bingo class sets, word scrambles, matching worksheets, and mazes. Preview the result and open the same layout in the editor. Connect your teacher account to export printable PDFs or save puzzles. Existing Pro accounts can include printable answer keys, watermark-free exports, and online assignments with student join codes. Students do not need accounts. English puzzle content is supported initially. Free accounts get 10 monthly exports shared with website usage.

defaultPrompt: Make an easy water-cycle word search using WATER, CLOUD, RAIN, VAPOR, and RIVER, and show me a preview.
Help me turn my vocabulary words and clues into a crossword.
Create 25 different bingo cards from my vocabulary list.
